grade.upstream_stored_answer: VTech CS6529-2 DECT 6.0 Phone Answering System with Caller ID/Call Waiting, 2 Cordless Handsets, Silver/Black
grade.reference_sql:
SELECT ttl FROM (
                    SELECT i.ttl, COUNT(*) as cnt
                    FROM items_g1 i JOIN fdbk_g1 f ON i.ref_id = f.ref_id
                    WHERE f.rtg = 1.0
                    GROUP BY i.ref_id, i.ttl
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT i.ttl, COUNT(*) as cnt
                    FROM items_g2 i JOIN fdbk_g2 f ON i.ref_id = f.ref_id
                    WHERE f.rtg = 1.0
                    GROUP BY i.ref_id, i.ttl
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT i.ttl, COUNT(*) as cnt
                    FROM items_g3 i JOIN fdbk_g3 f ON i.ref_id = f.ref_id
                    WHERE f.rtg = 1.0
                    GROUP BY i.ref_id, i.ttl
                )
                ORDER BY cnt DESC
                LIMIT 1
